answer: Most convincing sybil defense: quorum sampling. Each grading task goes to a small random committee drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing, an atlas of vetted graders, never fresh accounts. A new identity is a whisper that must build verified history before being sampled. Graders stake reputation; collusion or deviant verdicts slash it. Fake identities are cheap but influence is not: an attacker must age many accurate accounts while risking each stake, so one slip burns more than every fake lantern account earned.
